label: Social cognition / theory of mind
inputs: multi-agent tasks with private/false beliefs or goals that affect another agent's behavior
required_behavior: predict or act on another agent's latent information state beyond public-state behavior cloning
minimal_negative_twin: make all relevant beliefs/goals public or make behavior fully determined by public state + N0
strongest_parent: best predictor/controller measurable only from public environment state and observed action history + P0
falsifier: public-state parent matches; private state leaks; or the margin persists when private-state inference is unnecessary

label: Communication
inputs: sender-receiver tasks with task-relevant private information and a charged channel
required_behavior: transmit enough private information to improve receiver task utility, accounting for bits/latency/noise
minimal_negative_twin: give the receiver the sender's private information directly or make it irrelevant + N0
strongest_parent: best no-message/independent policy with shared public information and matched noncommunication resources + P0
falsifier: messages provide no net task gain; receiver accesses private state out of band; or the gain persists when receiver already has the information

label: Imitation
inputs: demonstrations from another agent plus an environment-interaction budget
required_behavior: use demonstrations to reach a target performance with fewer environment interactions or lower regret than independent learning
minimal_negative_twin: permute demonstrations so they are conditionally uninformative about the target behavior + N0
strongest_parent: best independent learner with the same environment interactions and compute but no informative demonstrations + P0
falsifier: sample-efficiency gain is absent; demonstrations include privileged target labels; or gain persists after demonstrations are made uninformative

label: Teaching
inputs: a teacher with knowledge, a learner state, selectable examples/messages, and charged teaching actions
required_behavior: select examples/messages conditioned on learner needs so learner utility rises beyond passive/random demonstration net of teacher cost
minimal_negative_twin: make all admissible examples equally informative to the learner + N0
strongest_parent: best passive broadcaster or random demonstrator with the same channel and example budget + P0
falsifier: learner-model-conditioned selection gives no gain; teacher sees forbidden evaluation answers; or advantage persists when example choice cannot matter

label: Cultural accumulation
inputs: multiple learner generations with bounded individual discovery budgets and transmissible artifacts/behavior
required_behavior: preserve and build on innovations so later-generation capability exceeds what any generation can rediscover within its individual budget
minimal_negative_twin: reset transmitted state between generations while preserving within-generation learning opportunities + N0
strongest_parent: best within-generation individual/social learner without cross-generation retained innovations + P0
falsifier: later performance never exceeds rediscovery envelope; external archives leak full solutions; or advantage persists when transmission is reset

label: Self-modeling
inputs: tasks requiring forecasts of the system's own future actions, errors, limitations, or resource use
required_behavior: predict self-dependent outcomes beyond a task-state-only parent and use them where preregistered to improve decisions
minimal_negative_twin: make self-outcomes fully determined by public task state + N0
strongest_parent: best predictor measurable from public task variables and externally observable outputs only + P0
falsifier: self-state adds no held-out predictive value; evaluation labels leak internally through the harness; or margin persists when public state is sufficient

label: Self-improvement
inputs: repeated tasks where the system may modify its own update/control/search policy at a charged modification cost
required_behavior: make a self-directed modification that improves future net utility or reduces search burden on held-out remints without violating stability constraints
minimal_negative_twin: remove future reuse so modification cost cannot amortize or freeze the environment to a one-shot task + N0
strongest_parent: best object-level learner with a fixed update/search law and otherwise matched resources + P0
falsifier: modification yields no held-out net gain; evaluator supplies the modification target; stability/rollback limits are violated; or gain persists when modification cannot amortize

label: Tool use
inputs: tasks with optional external artifacts/services that transform observations, actions, memory, or computation at charged cost
required_behavior: select and operate a tool so task utility or resource efficiency exceeds direct solving after tool cost
minimal_negative_twin: remove the tool's useful transformation or make direct solving strictly dominate it + N0
strongest_parent: best no-tool solver/controller with the same non-tool information and compute budget + P0
falsifier: tool use gives no net benefit; tool exposes forbidden answer labels; or margin persists when the tool is useless

label: Coordination / collective cognition
inputs: multiple agents with distributed information, parallel work, or specialization opportunities and charged communication
required_behavior: achieve team utility beyond the strongest noncoordinated aggregation under matched total compute, information, actions, and communication accounting
minimal_negative_twin: make all information fully shared and the task serial/nondecomposable so coordination cannot add value + N0
strongest_parent: best independent-agent aggregation or centralized no-communication parent under the same aggregate resource envelope + P0
falsifier: team surplus vanishes; agents receive hidden shared labels; aggregate resources are unmatched; or surplus persists when coordination opportunities are removed
